rationale: RMS magnitude and mean H-R cosine show different fixed-panel outcome covariation. The already captured q10, q50, and q90 tokenwise residual-RMS summaries permit a prospective test of whether lower, median, and upper portions of the token-magnitude distribution rank retention heterogeneity differently, without new model execution.

metric_boundary.measured: Three independently reported quantiles of tokenwise rms(R) at each frozen injection position.
metric_boundary.not_measured: Token identity, token spatial pattern, attribute direction, raw vector direction, or a causal path contribution.
metric_boundary.interpretation_limit: Differences among quantile-specific association patterns may indicate distribution-level readout heterogeneity but cannot by themselves be called concentration or sparsity.

prespecified_aggregation: For each of the three metrics separately, average all row-level values within every trace-task by CFG-branch by 3x3 block/denoising cell.
Require exact task-cell position counts of 119,119,112 across denoising early,middle,late for every seven-site block group.
Average the four seed task-cell values within each frozen reference unit.
Form positive-minus-control within each frozen matched pair.
Construct the already frozen eyeglasses and facial-hair outcomes exactly as in the two completed linkage analyses.
Join separately by metric, attribute, and formal_pair_id without a reduced panel.
Compute Spearman rank correlation with average ranks for all metric-by-attribute-by-branch-by-block-by-denoising combinations.

prospective_interpretation_rules.similar_patterns_across_q10_q50_q90: Compatible with a broad shift in tokenwise residual magnitude rankings, but not proof of uniform token participation.
prospective_interpretation_rules.stronger_or_different_q90_pattern: Compatible with upper-tail magnitude carrying different pair heterogeneity, but not proof of sparse or concentrated attribute writing.
prospective_interpretation_rules.stronger_or_different_q10_pattern: Compatible with lower-tail magnitude carrying different pair heterogeneity, but not proof of diffuse attribute writing.
prospective_interpretation_rules.mixed_signs_across_quantiles_or_grid: Evidence that quantile-specific magnitude readouts are state-dependent; not localization or causal direction.
prospective_interpretation_rules.near_zero_family: The recorded quantiles do not rank outcome heterogeneity in this panel; this does not refute local-route vector or token-pattern mechanisms.
